GAME BUTTON ICON. One small scene seen from the side and a little above, centred, as an icon on a command button in a top-down strategy game.

Images 1 and 2 are our approved pictures from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only, not their layout.

Create an ORIGINAL icon meaning "airdrop onto this place on the world map": at the bottom, one flat six-sided hexagon tile of green and tan land, like a single tile of a world map, with a small bold amber pin marker standing in its centre. Above it, THREE small round olive-drab parachutes are falling towards the tile, each with a tiny squarish olive cargo bundle hanging below it, spread out side by side at slightly different heights. At the very top, a small grey cargo aircraft seen from below flies across from left to right.

Style: an icon for the game RimWorld: a very thick near-black outline around every shape, bold simple shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, a muted palette with the amber pin as the only bright colour, readable when shrunk to 64 pixels. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

Draw ONLY the icon, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about three quarters of the canvas. Square canvas. No circle or ring around the icon, no people, hands, text, letters, numbers, roundels, logos or brand marks.
